name: lyric-rep
description: A home for stray song lines. iPhone PWA on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database that stores your lyrics. A new one is created for you.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Password you will type once on each device to unlock the app. Pick something only you know.
